The '''Imperial Grand Medal of Resolution''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] badge awarded to individuals who managed to "''quelled the Rebel scum at the [[Battle of Restuss]]''." It was slightly higher in rank than the [[Imperial Medal of Resolution]], awarded to individuals who, while not directly participating in driving out Rebels, nonetheless maintained law and order within Restuss.

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Grand Medal of Resolution appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011. Because of the player-optional nature of the Battle of Restuss, it is unknown whether the medal was ever canonically issued.
